title: Creation
description: God creates the heavens and the earth in six days

title: The Fall
description: Adam and Eve disobey God; expelled from Garden of Eden

title: Birth of Seth
description: Adam's third son born after Abel's murder; ancestor of Noah

title: Enoch Translated
description: Enoch walked with God and was taken without dying

title: The Flood
description: God sends a global flood; Noah and family preserved in the Ark

title: Tower of Babel
description: Nations dispersed after building tower; languages confused by God

title: Call of Abram
description: God calls Abram to leave Ur; promises land seed and blessing

title: Covenant of Circumcision
description: God establishes covenant sign with Abraham; name changed from Abram

title: Birth of Isaac
description: Isaac born to Abraham and Sarah in their old age; miracle child

title: Offering of Isaac
description: Abraham offers Isaac on Mt Moriah; God provides a substitute ram

title: Jacob's Ladder Dream
description: Jacob dreams of ladder to heaven; God renews the covenant with him

title: Jacob Renamed Israel
description: Jacob wrestles with God all night; renamed Israel meaning prince with God

title: Joseph Sold into Egypt
description: Joseph's brothers sell him to Ishmaelite traders for 20 pieces of silver

title: Joseph Made Prime Minister
description: Pharaoh elevates Joseph to rule over all Egypt after interpreting dreams

title: The Exodus
description: Moses leads Israel out of Egypt after 10 plagues; Passover instituted

title: Ten Commandments Given
description: God gives the Law to Moses at Mount Sinai; covenant established
